texts.preamble: A.Serma Pandi vs The Commissioner on 29 November, 2022 Author: V.Bhavani Subbaroyan Bench: V.Bhavani Subbaroyan 1 Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated 29.11.2022 Coram The Honourable Mrs.Justice V.Bhavani Subbaroyan W.P(MD)No.22781 of 2022 and W.M.P(MD)Nos.16924 and 16925 of 2022 A.Serma Pandi ..Petitioner Vs 1.The Commissioner, Food Safety Department, 5th Floor, 359, Anna Salai, Chennai 600 006. 2.The District Collector, Madurai District, Madurai. 3.The Designated Officer, Food Safety Department, Food Safety Wing, Madurai. 4.The Food Safety Officer(Code No.577), Madurai Corporation, Madurai. 5.The Inspector of Zpolice Theppakulam Police Station, Madurai. ..Respondents. Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of Ind praying this Court to issue a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus calling fo the records pertaining to the impugned order made in A.Serma Pandi vs The Commissioner on 29 November, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53385237/ 1 1514/Fsd/2022, dated 30.08.2022 passed by the third respondent and https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2 to quash the same and consequently to direct the respondents to remove the lock and seal of the Petitioner's Petty Shop and permit the petition to carry on the business in the same premises. For Petitioner :Mr.M.Kaliraj For Respondents:Mr.A.Kannan 1 to 3 For Respondent-4:Mr.S.Vinayak For Respondent-5:Mr.B.Thanga Aravindh Govt.Advocate(Crl.side) Order
texts.facts: The Petitioner has filed this Writ Petition seeking issuance of a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus calling for the records pertaining to the impugned order made in R.No.1514/FSD/2022, dated 30.08.2022 passed by the third respondent and to quash the same and consequently to direct the respondents to remove the lock and seal of the Petitioner's Petty Shop and permit the petitioner to carry on the business in the same premises. 3.This Court, in the above Writ Petition, by order, dated 16.11.2022, passed the following Order: https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis The petitioner is running a petty shop in the name and style of 'Sastha Maligai Shop' situated at Ismailpuram, 6th Street, Munichalai Road, Madurai for the past 25 years. The fifth respondent police registered a case against the petitioner alleging that on a raid on 25.08.2022, it was found that the petitioner was having 34 pockets of prohibited Ganesh Tobacco in his shop. Hence, he was arrested and a case was registered against him in Crime No.435 of 2022 for the offence under Section 24(1) of Cigarette and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 and he was also directed to pay fine. Under the said circumstances, the third respondent herein has issued the order impugned dated 30.08.2022 made in R.No. 1514/FSD/2022 under Section 34(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 and on the same day, the petitioner's shop was locked and sealed. Hence, the petitioner is before this Court.
texts.arguments: 2.The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has not committed any offence as alleged by the prosecution. 3.The learned Government Advocate (Crl.side) submitted that the petitioner is involved in three cases.
